# [CLUB NAME] Terms of Use

Effective [EFFECTIVE DATE].

These terms are between you and [CLUB LEGAL NAME] ("the club", "we", "us"), of [CLUB ADDRESS]. They cover the
club's app at [MEMBERS' APP ADDRESS] and what you book and buy through it. By joining or booking you agree to them,
to the club's waiver [IF THE CLUB HAS ONE], and to our Privacy Policy at [PRIVACY POLICY ADDRESS].

## Your account

- One account per person, in your own name. Keep your details right, and keep your sign-in to yourself: anything
  done in your account counts as done by you.
- You sign in with a code we email (or text, if you add a number), or with a passkey.
- You must be 18 or older to have an account of your own, or 13 or older with a login a parent gave you (see
  Families).

## Booking

- The club's booking rules (how far ahead you can book, how many bookings at once, the lengths, and cancelling) are
  shown in the app. The rules in force when you book are the ones that apply to that booking.
- A court is held for you for a few minutes while you pay. If someone else takes it meanwhile, it isn't booked and
  your money comes back.
- [THE CLUB'S OWN RULES: guests, no-shows, late arrival, court etiquette.]

## Paying

- Payments are by card, through Stripe. Apple Pay and Google Pay work too, as cards. Refunds go back to the card you
  paid with.
- **Sharing a court.** The organiser pays for the whole court, or only their part. With "only my part", each player
  pays their own share in the app, and the organiser's saved card is charged once, at the club's deadline, for
  whatever is still unpaid. Nothing is held on the card before then.
- **Open matches.** An open match that isn't full by its deadline is cancelled, and everyone gets their money back.
- **Saved cards.** If you save a card (for a membership, the family card, or "only my part"), you agree that the club
  may charge it for what you booked or signed up for, as the app said when you did.
- Prices are in US dollars and [INCLUDE OR DON'T INCLUDE] sales tax.

## Cancelling and refunds

- [THE CLUB'S CANCELLATION AND REFUND RULES, for courts, open matches, lessons, clinics and programs: how late you
  can cancel, and what you get back.]
- If you can't make a match, you can offer your place to a friend, or share a link with players at the match's
  level. Once someone takes it and pays, you get your money back. [WHAT HAPPENS IF NOBODY TAKES IT.]
- If the club cancels or moves something you booked, we tell you straight away, and [THE CLUB'S RULE: a full refund,
  or the choice of another time].
- A program, clinic or class that doesn't get enough players is cancelled, and [THE CLUB'S RULE: everyone is
  refunded in full].

## Memberships

- [THE CLUB'S MEMBERSHIP TERMS: what each plan includes, how long it lasts, when it renews and charges, how to
  cancel, and what happens to the rest of a period you've paid for.]
- A membership that renews charges your saved card at the start of each period, until you cancel it in the app.

## Families

- A parent adds their children under Family in the app, signs them up, books and pays for them, and accepts the
  waiver for each. Parents are responsible for their children's use of the app.
- From the year a child turns 13, a parent can give them a login of their own. The child can then book and join
  things themselves, paid on the family card within the rules the parents set (what they can book alone, and a
  monthly limit). Anything else comes to the parents to approve. The parents are responsible for what's charged to
  the family card.

## Waiver

[IF THE CLUB HAS A WAIVER: Before your first booking or sign-up, the app asks you to accept the club's waiver. If the
club changes it, you're asked again. The waiver's own words apply; nothing in these terms changes it.]

## Levels and results

The club's app works out each player's level from the results of rated games, so games are fair. Enter results
honestly. The club may correct a result or a level.

## Your own AI assistant

You can connect an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT or another) to the club, and choose how much it may spend for you
each week: nothing unless you choose more. What it books for you counts as booked by you, under these terms. It
always shows you what it will do first, and some things it never does (your sign-in, deleting your account,
accepting the waiver, your children's settings): you do those in the app. You can disconnect it at any time.

## Playing fair

- Treat other players, coaches and staff with respect, in the app and at the club.
- Don't make accounts for other people without their OK, book under a false name, or hold courts you won't use.
- Don't try to get into other people's accounts or the club's systems, copy the app's data in bulk, or get around
  its limits.
- The club may cancel bookings made against these rules, and may close an account that keeps breaking them. If it
  does, it refunds what the club's rules say.

## If the app is read-only

Now and then the club's app may be read-only for a while. If it is, you can still sign in, see everything, cancel
and leave with the club's usual refunds, and download your data, but nothing new can be booked or paid for until it
ends. The app says so at the top.

## Ending

You can delete your account at any time, in Profile, Your data, once nothing is still running (a booking to come,
a membership that renews, money owed). What's kept after is in our Privacy Policy.

## Responsibility

[THE CLUB'S LIABILITY WORDING, written with the waiver: for example, that padel is a sport with risk of injury,
which the waiver covers, and the limits of the club's liability for the app being unavailable or for a booking
that didn't go through.]

## Changes

We'll post new terms here with their date, and tell you in the app or by email before a change that matters takes
effect. Bookings already made keep the rules they were made under.
